title: Mossy Mayhem
body:
a mod i made for me and my friends that adds more functionality to moss.
its worth noting i have no idea what im doing and this is my first mod :sob:

- moss blocks now drop four moss clumps (which can be crafted back) when broken.
- clumps can be crafted into blocks or smelted into dried moss by smelting them.
- dried moss can be crafted into a block with nine clumps, and drops itself when broken.
- dried moss (and blocks) can be used as a fuel source
